# Notify events

The events the kernel sends. A pack names one command per event under `notify` in `pack.yaml`; an event the pack does not name is not sent.

## The command's contract

From `kernel/cockpitlib/notify.py`:

> Messages to the human. The pack names one command per event (notify.<event>: argv); the body goes on stdin. {event}, {key} and the caller's fields are filled into the arguments, and COCKPIT_EVENT and COCKPIT_EVENT_KEY are set, so one command (hermes send --to ... --file -) can serve every event. An event goes out once per key. A failed send is a red notify-<event> row in the Inbox until that event next goes out.

- **Arguments:** `{event}`, `{key}` and the event's own fields (below) are filled into each word.
- **Environment:** the caller's, plus `COCKPIT_EVENT` and `COCKPIT_EVENT_KEY`.
- **Standard input:** the message body.
- **Exit code:** 0 is sent; anything else is a failure, reported with the last line the command printed.
- **Time limit:** 120 seconds.
- **Event names** match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`.

## Events

| Event | Sent by | Key | Fields | Sent | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `advisory` | `ops.advisories_scan` | `<line.split(':', 1)[0].replace('NEW ALERT ', '')>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <line> |
| `ci_<what>` (`ci_failed`, `ci_green`) | `ci_watch._announce` | `<ticket>@<sha>` | `{sha}`, `{ticket}` | once per key | <ticket>: CI is <what> on <sha[:9]> |
| `pr_comments` | `pr_watch.watch` | `<repo>#<number>:<last>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <len(record['new'])> new comment(s) on <repo>#<number> ⏎ <record['url']> |
| `pr_stale` | `pr_watch.watch` | `<repo>#<number>@<record['head_sha'][:12]>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <repo>#<number> has been quiet since <iso_of(record['last_activity'])> ⏎ <record['url']> |
| `pr_stale_review` | `pr_watch.watch` | `<repo>#<number>@<record['head_sha'][:12]>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <repo>#<number> (you asked for changes) has been quiet since <iso_of(record['last_activity'])> ⏎ <record['url']> |
| `ready_for_review` | `gate.announce` | `<ticket> <' '.join(state['prs'])>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | (composed by the sender) |
| `rereview` | `pr_watch.watch` | `<repo>#<number>@<record['head_sha'][:12]>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <repo>#<number>: re-review started (card <card>) ⏎ <record['url']> |
| `standup` | `acts.standup_send` | `<time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')>` |  | each time the human sends it | (composed by the sender) |
| `ticket_done` | `pr_watch.watch` | `<ticket>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <ticket>: every PR is merged and nothing is open; its acknowledgement waits for you (<made>) |
| `tracker_comment` | `tracker_watch.watch` | `<note['id']>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | <ticket>: <reader.noun> comment <kind> by <row['author']> ⏎ <row['text'][:400]> ⏎ <note['url']> |
| `updated_after_review` | `gate.updated` | `<url>@<sha>` | `{ticket}` | once per key | (composed by the sender) |

In *Key* and *Body*, a name in angle brackets is a value the kernel fills in.
